issues: Sales target missed by 357 GBP per the meeting; spend per head and covers both down on voucher usage.
Delivery solid; prep times and order accuracy improved with extra sushi bar support.
Labour over target: supervisor training hours plus Penny's hours logged to the wrong site.
Food variance 9.6% per the meeting, partly recipe changes and matcha showing under both food and drink.
Baffling one star review claiming staff were throwing chairs (likely chairs being moved).
Staff: EA and Genua completed open and close training; Renry leaving hospitality on the 24th; Matt back from holiday on the 14th; BOH hiring started with Hanna Awang ahead of a chef holiday.
Compliance 95%; maintenance logs clear.
Upcoming: book launch (30 tickets sold), frozen ramen promo moved to the 19th; AGM hire approved by Ka Ho.
Region: food spend target temporarily raised to 26% until current promotions end (Matthew Jenner).
Region: hats or hairnets mandatory for all staff to prevent food contamination.
Region: menu to be redesigned with spice levels built into all ramen dishes and free chillies removed.
Region: GM and HC meeting notes must run through Google Meet so Gemini takes the notes; budget router templates updated, Monday dates must be entered correctly.
Covers were 1,944, up 22 (1.14%) year on year, and spend per head was £23.79, down £0.93 (3.76%) year on year.
Sales were £45,142.29 against the £45,500 target and down £5,191.70 year on year; the BOH meeting sheet shows £45,456.67, only £43 (0.10%) short.

Operational labour was 23.8% (£10,786.67) against a 22% target, up from 20.89% and the highest of the nine Scotland and Newcastle sites; labour all in was £12,589.51 (27.89%) and 736.87 hours were used.
Drinks mix was 14.71%, sushi 14.64% and sides 14.34%.
Food cost rose to 25.32% from 22.71%, which the BOH meeting put down to takeaway promotions, the loyalty programme and heavy takeaway packaging orders; drinks variance was 4.4%.
The site received seven 5 star, two 4 star and one 1 star Google reviews (4.40 average, down from 4.75); the GM confirmed no incident took place.
Cash up training for the new supervisors is complete and they start solo cash ups this week, with the GM on hand for troubleshooting and closer monitoring of their solo shifts.
A deep clean was completed to lift the hygiene compliance score, which had been an issue over the week.
A surge of customers signed up to the app this week, which the GM hopes will turn into customer retention.

Penny covered the site on the BOH call while Matt is away; BOH labour is shared with Maki 6 as one team member goes abroad for four months and a kitchen porter has resigned, so urgent KP hiring is needed on Matt's return.

Penny is overseeing Talent Funnel BOH hires to cover holidays and replace the KP, suggested taking back a former team member who has asked for his job (Matt to decide), and staff holiday planning starts in November.
The Slurp launch (wave 4, 06/11 to 08/11), XOXO, the lunch deal, app offers, freshers vouchers and the recipe change are also upcoming.
Improving the volume and quality of reviews is a stated area for improvement, and GM business outreach continues as in previous weeks.

Region: five of the nine Scotland and Newcastle sites ran food cost above 25% (Maki 12, 1, 7, 3 and 8), which the Scotland BOH meeting of 13/10 linked to loyalty programme and delivery platform discounts across the group.

Region: new tonkotsu and chicken broth arrives from 15/10 and needs no added water; defrost it a day ahead and reheat it in a pot rather than straight on the heat, and a digital Brix meter is arriving to replace checking by eye, though not every site has one yet (Scotland BOH meeting 13/10).

Region: new chicken arrives on 15/10 and the new char siu (different shape) and pre cooked frozen beef from 19/10, starting at Maki 8; defrost the beef a day ahead and grill or pan fry it for 15 seconds a side before slicing, holding extra stock because it cannot be used on the day it arrives (Scotland BOH meeting 13/10).

Region: the frozen ramen promotion is postponed by one week, and Penny is checking with Michael whether frozen ramen counts in food cost or separately, as some sites have already bought it (Scotland BOH meeting 13/10).
Site efficiency was red at 78 and delivery sales were over £4,000 (AM Updates 14/10).
Ka Ho discussed the wage revenue spike with Penny and Scott (AM Updates 14/10).

Region: Ka Ho put food cost of 25.3% to 27.2% at Maki 1, Fountainbridge, M7, M8 and M12 down to promotions lifting usage while sales projections were not adjusted; Michael said site leaders can ask for food cost and wage budget increases (AM Updates 14/10).
Region: a level 8 Halloween ramen with a super spicy factory chilli paste is launching with a video; one bag per site, about a teaspoon per bowl (AM Updates 14/10).
Region: snooze out of stock items on both Deliverect and the POS, or the whole delivery order fails (AM Updates 14/10).
Region: wage revenue baseline is 21% with up to 2% leeway; drinks cost moves to management, food cost to head chefs, new OKRs due end of November (AM Updates 14/10).
